name: Review — Halden Analytics SaaS agreement, redline v1
turns: Reviewing Halden Analytics' redline v1 of the SaaS subscription agreement (HAL-SAAS-2025); attached.
10.1 keeps the 12-month general cap but adds a 24-month super-cap for personal-data breach claims. 12.1 has Halden keeping ownership of its platform.
The data-breach super-cap is reasonable: Halden processes our shipment and customer data. Accept 24 months for breach claims only, never as the general cap.
On 12.1, the playbook lets a vendor keep its pre-existing platform as long as our data and the reports generated from it stay ours. The redline says exactly that.
Agreed, accept 12.1 as written. Payment is net 45, which is standard. We sign on 2025-06-18.
precedents: Halden Analytics precedent (SaaS agreement signed 2025-06-18): liability cap 12 months of fees, with a 24-month super-cap for personal-data breach claims only.
Halden Analytics precedent (SaaS agreement signed 2025-06-18): Halden keeps its platform IP; Harbrook owns its data and all reports generated from it.
